term.definitionEn: Manufacture of building materials for structures, such as ceramic/fiber-cement siding, wood-cement or other cement-based exterior wall panels, and concrete products. Does not include wholesaling or retailing building materials without manufacturing them.

term.labelJa: 住宅設備機器（衛生陶器等）
term.definitionJa: 浴槽・洗面手洗器・便器等の衛生陶器、およびその配管用取付品・附属品を製造する住宅設備機器事業。住宅そのものの建築・分譲は別区分(住宅)とする。
term.definitionEn: Manufacture of housing/building equipment such as sanitary ware (bathtubs, wash basins, toilets) and their plumbing fittings/accessories. Does not include building or selling the house itself, which is a separate term.
